text:
maria-g: Quick sync — drafted cutover plan for US-WEST-3. main asks: routing policy confirmation, KMS/data residency owners, and a tiny canary plan. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/612
alex-h: taking a look now, will comment on infra PR in ~30m. any hard blockers you know of?
maria-g: nothing major yet. milestones: config freeze Tue 09:00 UTC, canary Thu 02:00 UTC. need owners for KMS key provisioning and DNS TTL change.
ken-l: tagging infra here — @sophia-p can you confirm KMS region support for us-west-3? we might need a separate CMK per tenancy for enterprise customers.
sophia-p: I can provision CMKs, but need the customer list that requires dedicated keys. infra will need ~3 business days for HSM request + IAM bindings.
alex-h: noted. for routing: proposal is residency-first, fallback to latency. sample rule in draft config below:
```
routing_policy:
  primary: residency
  fallback: latency
  residency_map:
    EU: eu-west-1
    NA: us-west-3
```
ken-l: looks good. question — do we prefer DNS-level routing or edge-proxy? DNS gives faster failover but harder to do sticky KV cache routing.
maria-g: ops preference is edge-proxy because of KV cache affinity. DNS fallback only for full-region failures.
alex-h: agree. Alex will own proxy rollout, Ken will own DNS fallback runbook. Can we add a test to the e2e infra suite to simulate region drain?
ken-l: will add a test that simulates node drain + KV flush. PR link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/615
sophia-p: FYI, cross-account IAM for partners requires an extra role. I'll add notes to the onboarding doc.
infra-bot: deploy plan created: deploy/us-west-3/canary — window Thu 02:00-04:00 UTC (10% traffic), rollback policy: immediate on 5xx > 0.5% for 5m.
maria-g: can whoever's reviewing infra PRs plz prioritize? we need approvals by Mon EOD to hit freeze. tagging @alex-h @ken-l.
alex-h: putting in review now. left one small comment about fallback ordering.
ken-l: I'll review after my stand. expect comments in 1-2 hours.
sophia-p: added KMS provisioning checklist to the doc: https://confluence.redwood/infrastructure/kms-usw3. includes contact for compliance.
maria-g: ownership recap: platform — routing config + canary; infra — KMS + DNS fallback; eng-sre — runbook + monitoring alerts. please reply if that isn't right.
alex-h: correct from platform side.
ken-l: correct for infra.
sophia-p: correct for KMS.
maria-g: final ask — can someone from eng-sre add a Prometheus rule for region_error_rate > 0.5% during canary and a pager duty runbook? otherwise I'll schedule a brief dry run Wed.
deploy-bot: alert-channel created: #deploy-us-west-3-canary.
ken-l: I'll take the dry run with eng-sre on Wed 18:00 UTC.
maria-g: thanks everyone — will update the PR with an explicit canary checklist and schedule. :thumbsup:
alex-h: merging post-approvals, will notify when canary starts.
